description_en: Retrieves the status of an interactive Spark job
description_zh: 获取可交互Spark作业的状态
name: GetSparkSessionState

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark job. You can log on to the DLA console (https://datalakeanalytics.console.aliyun.com/) and obtain the job ID from the job list
parameters.help_zh: Spark作业的ID。您可以登录DLA控制台 (https://datalakeanalytics.console.aliyun.com/)，在作业任务列表中获取作业任务ID
parameters.name: job_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

State.description_en: The internal status of the Spark job, such as running, success, starting, killing, or failed
State.description_zh: Spark作业的各种内部状态，如running、success、starting、killing、failed，等等
